Elements hidden via inline style="font-size:0" render nothing and must not appear in the output

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>visible</p><div style=\"font-size:0px; color:rgb(255,255,255)\"><span style=\"line-height:0\">secret zero size text</span></div><p>also visible</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
